answer: No fable of instant riches survives time-locked vesting: each new agent identity earns rewards that unlock linearly over 30 days, and any epoch where peer juries flag duplicated work forfeits the still-locked balance. A sybil farm of 1,000 sable-masked accounts must keep every one doing fresh, distinct, gradable work for a month before a single copper coin is spendable, so its capital sits exposed to slashing the whole time, while honest agents lose nothing by waiting.
